name: Dispensary Districts 1 Apr 1921
description: The 177 dispensary districts in the six counties from 1 Apr 1921, when the unions that crossed the new border were reorganised, until 31 Mar 1924. The Belleek, Clones No. 2 and Crossmaglen areas passed with their districts to the Irvinestown, Lisnaskea and Newry Unions, and the Cavan districts of Enniskillen Union and the Donegal districts of Londonderry and Strabane Unions were taken out. Each district is a group of the old (pre-1923) electoral divisions on Civgraph's 3 May 1921 DED map (Paddy Matthews, with Phelim Birch's corrections), because the Ministry of Home Affairs ordered in 1925 that dispensary districts stay as they were before the 1923 reconstitution of the divisions. The district of each old division is the one its townlands carry in the 1926 Census Topographical Index, checked against the district lists of the 1926 county volumes (Table 4) and the order of the 1911 Census Table VI. Ten old divisions were shared between districts; these are split on OSNI townland lines (Brownlows Derry, Ballygomartin, Ballysillan, Monkstown, Ardclinis, Beardiville, Portrush Rural, Kilkeel, Newry Rural and Drumnakilly). The 16 Belfast urban districts and the Londonderry urban districts other than Waterside cross ward lines along streets, so each county borough's urban districts are shown as one undivided area. With the large loughs taken out, 93 of the 97 county parts whose 1926 printed area could be read agree within 2% (median 0.06%); each district carries its grade and the reason for it (confidence, confidence_reason). Dispensary districts were also the registrars' districts for births, deaths and marriages. No dispensary district change between 1921 and 1926 is recorded (the 1926 General Report does not list them), so the 1926 districts are carried back; Portaferry is in Downpatrick Union.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1926: General Report
references.note: Administrative divisions pp. xvii-xviii, changes (i)-(q) dated 1 Apr 1921; Table 4 notes: two dispensary districts in County Cavan (Enniskillen Union), three in County Donegal (Londonderry Union) and two in County Donegal (Strabane Union) no longer included.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 229 (Poor Law Dispensary Districts)
references.note: 13 Nov 1925, p. 338. Ministry of Home Affairs order under s. 9(1) of the Local Government Act (NI) 1923: the boundaries and contents of the dispensary districts remain as they were before the orders altering the district electoral divisions.

references.note: Index 6 (dispensary or registrars' districts, with their union) and Index 9 (townlands, each with its dispensary district), read from the OCR text; about 6,200 townland entries matched to OSNI townlands.

references.note: Poor Law Unions, Dispensary Districts and District Electoral Divisions: the DEDs (and parts of DEDs) in each dispensary district, with its area; used to check placements and areas.
